page.overview:
What is Lake Acuity?

Lake Acuity is one of three lakes of the Sinnoh region (formerly Hisui in ). In the center of the lake is Acuity Cavern, home of Uxie. Lake Acuity is in the northernmost part of Sinnoh, which is also the coldest, so the surrounding areas are always covered in snow.

The word "acuity" means "sharpness or acuteness of wit," a fitting title namely because Uxie is the Being of Knowledge.

In Pokémon Legends : Arceus, it is part of the Alabaster Icelands. Volo mentions that the lake is filled with seawater, and that explains why it doesn't freeze.

To see the encounters in Pokémon Legends : Arceus, please go to the following article : Lake Acuity (Hisui)
